design: Interface and mathematical target-clock audit, not a new coverage or personality accuracy study. Six fixed authors, repeated across two targets and six observation masks.
qualification_scope: Masks test the scoring consequence of absent or previously disqualified numeric records, not a natural-language eligibility classifier.
failure_rule: Retain unsupported personal/source results and do not renormalize the mixture; no post-result repair of mask, threshold or model.
full_prefix_rule: Compare against archived complete-prefix score, variance and source normalization under original tolerance.
cold_rule: Each of the 72 complete result objects must match a separate-process replay exactly.
